title: Grenadiers Gameplay WebSocket Protocol v14
description: Gameplay contract adding selectable Easy and Standard solo CPU metadata to the unchanged v11 physical projection.

GameClientMessage.description: Client message union: authenticate first, then sequenced room and gameplay commands.

Authenticate.description: First client message; presents the live protocol version and a single-use session token.

CreateRoom.description: Creates a room and admits the authenticated connection to its first seat.

JoinRoom.description: Joins an existing room by its public room code.

Ready.description: Sets this seat's readiness against the identified round and settings revision.

Movement.description: Sets or clears the seat's current movement direction for the active round.

LeaveRoom.description: Leaves the identified room and invalidates that seat's resume capability.

GameServerMessage.description: Server message union for authentication, admission, recipient-filtered state, acknowledgements, and errors.

Authenticated.description: Confirms session authentication and the selected live protocol version.

IncompatibleProtocol.description: Rejects an unsupported protocol version and reports the version accepted by the server.

RoomState.description: Publishes recipient-visible room metadata and lifecycle state outside a running simulation snapshot.

Snapshot.description: Publishes a recipient-filtered simulation state and its bounded event batch.

LeftRoom.description: Acknowledges the sequenced leave command for the identified room.

Error.description: Reports a protocol or command error; sequence is non-null only when correlated to a command.

Rematch.description: Sets this seat's rematch readiness after a completed match.

ResumeRoom.description: Restores a room seat using its private resume capability.

Admitted.description: Confirms room admission with recipient-private seat, resume capability, and nullable current state.

SeatReplaced.description: Notifies the previous connection that a successful resume replaced its seat binding.

GameSettings.description: Validated live room settings, including the enabled subset of the 22-item catalog.

UpdateSettingsCommand.description: Replaces editable room settings using optimistic revision matching.

ManualAction.description: Requests a deduplicated bomb or equipment action for the active round.
